title: Pocketwire Business Profile Refund Exposure Bands for Bank Payouts
content:
The refund exposure percentage on a Pocketwire Business Profile is 5 percent when the refunds dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date are at least 0.05 (5 percent) of the sales dated in that month, 2 percent when they are at least 0.02 (2 percent) but less than 0.05 of them, and nothing when they are less. Refunds and sales are measured by amount. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Refunds as a share of the rolling month's sales | Refund exposure percentage |
|---|---|
| 5 percent or more | 5 percent |
| 2 percent or more, below 5 percent | 2 percent |
| below 2 percent | none |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical month with USD 10000.00 of sales)

| Refunds in the month | Refund exposure percentage |
|---|---|
| USD 500.00 | 5 percent |
| USD 499.99 | 2 percent |
| USD 200.00 | 2 percent |
| USD 199.99 | none |
